newsitem.title: JAPAN: Weak earthquake shakes Tokyo, no casualties seen.
newsitem.headline: Weak earthquake shakes Tokyo, no casualties seen.

text.p: A weak earthquake shook Japan's main island of Honshu in and around Tokyo early on Saturday morning but there were no immediate reports of casualties or damage, a Meteorological Agency spokesman said.

The spokesman said the earthquake measured three on the Japanese scale -- a weak-size tremor -- and 5.1 on the open-ended Richter scale in metropolitan Tokyo and the prefecture of Saitama, immediately west of the capital.
He said there was no danger of tidal waves from the tremor, which happened at about 5.34 a.m.(2034 GMT).
